name: Different, Not Less — Chloé Hayden
description: Lived-experience guide and memoir by autistic and ADHD author Chloé Hayden about neurodivergence, school, sensory experiences, stimming, diagnosis, community and adulthood.
intended_use: Inspect an autistic/ADHD lived-experience perspective aimed at self-understanding and inclusion.
audience_or_context: Neurodivergent readers, younger adults, families and supporters seeking accessible lived-experience writing.
limitations: The book reflects one author's experience and practical advice; it is not diagnostic guidance or evidence that any strategy fits everyone.
Cultural and service context includes the author's Australian experience and may not map directly to UK systems.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial book; prices, formats and availability vary by country and retailer.
conflicts_of_interest: The author and publisher sell the book; ND Oracle lists it as lived-experience/practical media, not independent evidence.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
